'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Ryan Sellman DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Sellman]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Username:''' Sne89837
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
